evidence: CustomUnit.applyProjectileTemplateToProjectile reuses Projectile.aP only when it is a lightEffect attached to the projectile, and stores newly created attached light effects in aP for instantReuseLast.
EffectEngine.createLineEffect stores the target world X in M and draw() converts M/N/O into a screen point for the line endpoint.
EffectEngine.createLineEffect stores the target world Y in N and draw() converts M/N/O into a screen point for the line endpoint.
EffectEngine.createLineEffect stores the target height in O and draw() converts M/N/O into a screen point for the line endpoint.
EffectInstance.draw offsets the destination rect by sin((lifeMax-lifeRemaining)/T*360)*S when S != 0.
EffectInstance.draw divides elapsed life by T for the S-amplitude oscillation offset.
EffectInstance.draw adds ac to the destination rect center X before drawing aa text.
EffectInstance.draw adds ad to the destination rect center Y before drawing aa text.
EffectInstance.draw compares au against the current computed alpha before updating the mutable draw paint.
EffectInstance.draw compares elapsed life against z and linearly blends to fadeToColor over this time; reset sets z=-1.
EffectInstance.draw compares static D against the computed draw tint before reusing static LightingColorFilter C.
EffectInstance.draw compares av against the current computed RGB tint before updating the mutable draw paint.
EffectEngine built-in wrappers assign one of the static effect kind constants to EffectInstance.g before draw/update uses the selected strip behavior.
EffectInstance.draw blends base color toward field y while z is non-negative; reset sets y=-1.
EffectInstance.draw caches the last LightingColorFilter in static C before assigning it to instance field B.
EffectInstance.draw uses ab instead of the effect draw paint when rendering text if ab is non-null.
EffectInstance.draw renders aa as a string centered on the effect destination rect.
EffectEngine.createLineEffect sets L=true; draw() renders a line from the effect rect to M/N/O when L is true.
EffectInstance.draw toggles aw when it applies or clears a LightingColorFilter on the mutable draw paint.
CustomUnit projectile light path sets EffectInstance.c when CustomProjectileTemplate.lightCastOnGround is true.
EffectEngine.createLightEffect sets d=true; CustomUnit projectile light reuse requires attachedObject==projectile and d==true.
EffectEngine constructor initializes effect-pool thresholds, reusable arrays, paints and built-in effect image-strip holders.
Small helper delegates directly to CommonUtils random float in [min,max].
EffectTemplate BuiltInEffectType.smallExplosion calls this helper; large explosion cluster also uses it as the repeated child effect.
EffectTemplate BuiltInEffectType.largeExplosion calls this void helper; it emits a randomized cluster via the 5-arg overload.
EffectTemplate BuiltInEffectType.small calls this overload; it delegates to the small built-in effect path with default color.
Randomized cluster helper loops seven times and creates small explosion/debris effects around the input point.
Creates an effect at start XYZ, sets drawLineTo=true, and stores target XYZ in EffectInstance.M/N/O.
Small built-in effect overload accepts a color tint and delegates to the variant helper.
EffectTemplate BuiltInEffectType.medium/large call this path; medium adjusts returned scale to 0.75, large uses the default scale.
EffectTemplate BuiltInEffectType.smoke calls this path and passes direction plus optional tint color.
Creates the small built-in animated effect; second int selects the small-effect animation variant.
Creates a non-fog light effect, marks lightEffect=true, assigns effect kind h and optional LightingColorFilter color.
Resource-pool smoke branch wraps the shockwave-style effect and switches image-strip index to 11.
EffectTemplate BuiltInEffectType.shockwave calls this path; it creates the ring/shockwave-style effect and optional color filter.
Static helper assigns EffectInstance.attachedObject and converts world coordinates into object-relative offsets.
Overload creates a light effect for a WorldObject using the default size 0.5.
Overload creates a light effect at the object position, zeroes its relative offset and attaches it to the object.
